adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic.rb`, `expandable_first_post?` was changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`, removing any check that embedding is currently enabled/allowed. With this diff, if an admin deletes all `EmbeddableHost` records (embedding effectively disabled for new requests via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`), previously imported topics that still return `has_topic_embed? == true` will continue to have expandable first posts whenever `SiteSetting.embed_truncate?` is true. The updated spec section also no longer pins the old “no hosts => false” behavior: the test named "is false if embeddable_host is blank" now passes without setting `embed_truncate` true or stubbing `has_topic_embed?` true, so it doesn’t verify the missing guard.
